title: Quota draw
description: Body of an `evidence` artifact, and the data of the `quota.draw` event that names it: what one agent run of a derived Worker on a declared pool drew from each window of its account's pool, from the window's last reading before the run and its first reading after it (design/resources.md, quota drawn per run; PROP-0015 E2). One entry per window, never one figure for the account. A draw is the rise of the window's used share in percentage points, recorded only when both readings give a used share and belong to the same window epoch (the same reset). Nothing is estimated: a missing reading leaves no draw, and a draw is never negative.

runId.description: The agent run (its execution id), as its usage record names it.

pool.description: The account's pool the run drew on (`<template>/<account>`).

workflowRunId.description: The workflow run the agent run belongs to, when it belongs to one.

template.description: The workflow template of that run, as the engine started the step (`WorkerStart.step`).

step.description: The template's step (node id) the run served.

kind.description: The kind of work the run was admitted for (`WorkRequirement.kind`, ADR-0057), from the admitted spec, never from model text.

startedAt.description: When the run was submitted to its runtime: the reading before is the window's latest at this time.

endedAt.description: When the runtime returned: the reading after is the first one observed at or after this time (the account's usage report read after the run, ADR-0059).

overlapping.description: How many other runs on the same account ran at some time between `startedAt` and `endedAt`. Above 0, every window's entry with a draw is `confounded`: the rise is not this run's alone.

windows.description: One entry per configured window of the pool, in the pool's order.

reading.description: A window's reading as the ledger recorded it (`limit-state@1.0`): its used share, its epoch (the later of `resetsAt` and `cooldownUntil`, as `accountQuotaOf` reads it; absent when it names neither), and when it was observed.

entry.description: One window's draw. `state`: clean, a draw that counts in the figures; confounded, a draw while another run on the account overlapped (`overlapping`), kept but out of the figures; reset-crossing, no draw: the readings' epochs differ, either names no reset, or the used share went down; no-reading, no draw: a reading before or after is missing, or gives no used share.

seconds.description: The window's length, when it has one.

draw.description: The rise of the used share from `before` to `after`, in percentage points of the window's allowance (0 to 100).

why.description: Why the entry has no draw, or why it is confounded, in words.
